architecturePolicy.reason: POST-004 is intended to test whether additional controlled optimization can unlock generation before introducing architectural confounders.

dataPolicy.developmentStrategy: Use a separate POST-004 development split for candidate selection. Formal POST-003 data must remain unseen by the optimization and candidate-selection process.
dataPolicy.trainingStrategy: Use a POST-004 training dataset derived independently from the sealed formal examples, balanced across the same capability families and response-character patterns.

decodingPolicy.reason: POST-004 must improve the model rather than conceal generation weakness with decoding heuristics.

developmentSelection.minimumCondition: Selected candidate must demonstrate non-zero exact generation on development examples.
developmentSelection.tieBreak: Prefer more families with exact matches, then lower aggregate response loss, then earlier training step.

observations: Correct response characters are sometimes near the top of the distribution but frequently do not win greedy decoding.
Failure is not restricted to the first response token; teacher-forced probes reveal weak internal response transitions.
Some later response transitions are already correctly ranked first, demonstrating partial sequence learning.
The model remains highly uncertain across the 42-character vocabulary.
The newline response terminator is represented during supervised training and generation.

requiredForPass: POST-004 candidate exact-match count must be strictly greater than POST-003 baseline exact matches.
POST-004 candidate must achieve at least one formal exact match.
No capability family may exceed the predefined loss-regression tolerance.
Aggregate response loss must remain within the predefined retention tolerance relative to the accepted POST-003 checkpoint.

plannedOptimization.selectionPolicy: Train one deterministic trajectory from the accepted POST-003 checkpoint and snapshot at predeclared steps 40, 80, and 120. Development evaluation may select exactly one candidate for a single formal evaluation.

primaryGoal: Convert POST-003 partial response-token learning into measurable autoregressive generation capability while preserving the accepted POST-003 formal-loss gain.

rollbackPolicy.onFailure: Retain POST-003 as accepted checkpoint and design POST-005 only after analyzing POST-004 diagnostics.
rejectCandidateIf: aggregate response loss regresses by more than 2 percent
any family response loss regresses by more than 5 percent

trainingHypothesis: POST-003's 20-step mixed-objective run produced measurable loss improvement and partial response-transition learning, but provided insufficient optimization exposure for stable autoregressive sequence generation.
